description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-13. -->
## YouTube Music

- **Glass miniplayer and navigation bar (#47):** Add Morphe's glass styles with separate controls, live
  previews, blur, tint, opacity, size, rim brightness and optional spinning artwork. Both are **off by default**.
  Enable **RVX settings > Player > Enable glass miniplayer** or
  **RVX settings > Navigation bar > Enable glass navigation bar**. Requires Music 8.51 or newer;
  older versions skip the patch with a warning. Background blur requires Android 14 or newer.
- **Older-version patching:** Fix the download-button bytecode error on Music 8.30. Restore Scrobbling and
  playlist track tap actions on 6.20. Skip unsupported speed slider/pitch and external podcast restriction
  hooks below 7.25, with warnings, instead of failing the patch run. Exclusive audio playback stays available.
- **Lyrics:** Recognize local line-timed LRC files as synchronized lyrics. Fix incompatible account headers
  and retry transient YouTube Music lyrics failures instead of keeping cached misses.
- **Dark theme:** Apply the chosen palette to the offline dialog, including older precompiled themes.

## YouTube

- **Yellow repeat (#48):** At the end of the video, rewind and pause through the native controller.
  Play resumes the same video instead of getting stuck. Blue repeat and repeat-off autoplay stay unchanged.
- **Music buttons:** Detect the configured app on Android 10 and older, and send encoded song links to
  third-party clients through their link-handling activity.
- **Feed and layout:** Preserve the imported Playback in feeds mode. Keep Home filters with toolbar
  Subscriptions tabs while respecting Hide category bar. Hide newer horizontal shelves and portrait Ask
  buttons, and open the description when tapping the watch title's channel subtitle.
- **Quality and compatibility:** Keep live-stream buffers when selecting quality to avoid catch-up stutter.
  Fix engagement-panel matching after feed-layout hooks, prevent end-of-video scrolling on 21.33 and newer,
  and allow background notifications without artwork on 20.51 and newer.

## Both apps

- **Profile handle (#46):** Show the handle by default. Hide handle remains optional; its account-menu switch
  is available again on newer Music versions. Existing saved choices are kept, so turn Hide handle off if needed.
- **Stream spoofing:** Warn when JavaScript clients need a missing or outdated WebView, with repair links
  and a persistent dismissal. Retry visionOS attestation-test streams with a fresh visitor ID. Avoid OAuth
  connection-error notices before the startup network is ready, while keeping invalid-login warnings.

This is a development prerelease, not a stable release. Update this fork's development source in Morphe
Manager, then patch and install again.
